title: DGX Fleet — Command Center
description: Is the fleet healthy, what needs attention, and how is each Spark doing. New Sparks appear by themselves.

panels.title: Fleet status
panels.description: From the alerts that are firing now: any critical makes this red, any warning amber. Info alerts do not count. If this says MONITORING BLIND, Prometheus itself is not answering.

panels.title: Sparks
panels.description: Online and down are from Prometheus scrapes. Waiting means fleet discovery saw a Spark on the LAN that is not reporting yet; the Monitoring page says why.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Every container on every Spark, not only TechSara's.

panels.title: Databases
panels.description: Detected automatically, on every Spark. Up means the engine answered in its own protocol.

panels.title: GPU power
panels.description: All GPU rails added up. Not wall power: this hardware has no sensor for that.

panels.title: Hottest GPU
panels.description: Shared SoC temperature. Slowdown at 86 °C, shutdown at 90 °C.

panels.title: Engine
panels.description: The engine state, from a real completion and not from a process being alive. READY and BUSY serve; DEGRADED serves with a warning; WEDGED, RECOVERING and QUEUEING hold requests; DOWN needs a person.

panels.title: Readiness
panels.description: Proven means the last canary completion succeeded and both GPUs were seen working.

panels.title: Worker rank
panels.description: Is the worker's model process alive, according to the sentinel on that Spark. Unknown while the sentinel cannot be reached.

panels.title: Last inference
panels.description: Seconds since a real streamed completion finished. A hung process cannot fake this.

panels.title: Recoveries 1h
panels.description: Coordinated restarts the controller started in the last hour. The budget is 3 an hour.

panels.title: Last failure
panels.description: The kind of the last failure. This is history, not status: it keeps its value after recovery, so read it with Incident. Grey on purpose.

panels.title: Queued for recovery
panels.description: Accepted requests held while the model is not ready. They resume by themselves.

panels.title: KV cache
panels.description: Above about 90 % vLLM starts preempting requests.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Everything firing now. Definitions and history: the Alerts + SLO page. Empty means nothing is firing.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, node, container, device, service) (ALERTS_FOR_STATE and ignoring (alertstate) ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) * 1000

panels.title: Containers in trouble
panels.description: Failing a health check, stopped when its restart policy says it should run, or restarted in the last hour. Empty means none.

targets.expr: max by (node, container, project) ((spark_container_expected_running == 1) and on (node, container) (spark_container_running == 0))

panels.title: All Sparks
panels.description: One row per Spark. Click a name for everything about it. A Spark that dies stays listed as DOWN. Blank means the reading is missing, not zero. Power cuts: shutdowns the SSD was not warned about, over its whole life.

panels.title: Now
panels.description: GPU busy is not load: the model's worker rank spins at about 95 % while it waits, so read it with GPU power.

panels.title: Live correlation: one time axis, to explain a dip
Engine state
panels.description: A gap is a gap: a stale controller verdict draws nothing rather than a line across it.

panels.title: GPU power
panels.description: The honest load signal: a spinning rank reads 95 % busy at about 34 W.

panels.title: Swap traffic
panels.description: Pages in and out per second. Sustained traffic means memory pressure, and it slows the model.

panels.title: Stalled on memory
panels.description: Share of time every task was blocked waiting for memory (PSI full).

panels.title: RoCE fabric
panels.description: Received above the line, sent below. Rises during generation: the proof the model is really distributed.

panels.title: All databases
panels.description: Found automatically on every Spark. Status, version, connections, CPU, memory and disk need no login. Detail says what else is known: `login` means full statistics, `info` means the engine answers without one, `liveness` means no credentials are in use for this project. Blank means not measured, not zero.

targets.expr: max by (node, container, engine, project, version, stats) (spark_db_info)
100 * sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_db_cache_reads_total{source="hit"}[5m])) / sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_db_cache_reads_total[5m]) > 0)
sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_cpu_seconds_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up)
max by (node, container) (spark_container_memory_working_set_bytes and on (node, container) spark_db_up)
max by (node, container) (spark_container_memory_swap_bytes and on (node, container) spark_db_up)
sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_disk_written_bytes_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up)

panels.title: Application endpoints
panels.description: HTTP probes of the services that have no metrics of their own.
